title: Diagnostic Medical Sonographers
description: Produce ultrasonic recordings of internal organs for use by physicians. Includes vascular technologists.

tasks.text: Observe screen during scan to ensure that image produced is satisfactory for diagnostic purposes, making adjustments to equipment as required.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Display monitoring partly automatable; clinical judgment human

dwas.name: Monitor video displays of medical equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Adjust settings or positions of medical equipment.

tasks.text: Decide which images to include, looking for differences between healthy and pathological areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Patient positioning and scanner operation hands-on

dwas.name: Create advanced digital images of patients using computer imaging systems.

tasks.text: Operate ultrasound equipment to produce and record images of the motion, shape, and composition of blood, organs, tissues, or bodily masses, such as fluid accumulations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Imaging equipment operated with patient positioning

dwas.name: Operate diagnostic imaging equipment.

tasks.text: Observe and care for patients throughout examinations to ensure their safety and comfort.
tasks.rationale: decision support — In-procedure patient monitoring is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Monitor patient conditions during treatments, procedures, or activities.

tasks.text: Provide sonogram and oral or written summary of technical findings to physician for use in medical diagnosis.

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Obtain and record accurate patient history, including prior test results or information from physical examinations.

dwas.name: Gather medical information from patient histories.
Record patient medical histories.

dwas.name: Explain medical procedures or test results to patients or family members.

dwas.name: Position patients for treatment or examination.
Prepare patients physically for medical procedures.

tasks.text: Maintain records that include patient information, sonographs and interpretations, files of correspondence, publications and regulations, or quality assurance records, such as pathology, biopsy, or post-operative reports.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Create advanced digital images of patients using computer imaging systems.
Operate diagnostic imaging equipment.

tasks.text: Perform clerical duties, such as scheduling exams or special procedures, keeping records, or archiving computerized images.

dwas.name: Schedule patient procedures or appointments.
Maintain medical facility records.
Perform clerical work in medical settings.

dwas.name: Examine medical instruments or equipment to ensure proper operation.
Clean medical equipment or facilities.
Repair medical facility equipment.

dwas.name: Train medical providers.
Supervise patient care personnel.

tasks.text: Perform medical procedures, such as administering oxygen, inserting and removing airways, taking vital signs, or giving emergency treatment, such as first aid or cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR).

Implement advanced life support techniques.

Order medical supplies or equipment.
